title: Doorman + Graves: Cart through Grasping Hands into the gravestone
question: Does carting a target through Grasping Hands into Borrowed Decree land more ghoul explosions than the target walking out of the zone?
hypothesis: H-B3-3.1 Cart through the hands roots the target (1.75s at T3). H-B3-3.2 ghoul explosions on the target per Decree >=2x vs no Doorman. H-B3-3.3 an 8.5s wall (Duration Extender) gives >=1.5s spare for the Cart every trial.

arms.name: graves_alone
arms.notes: Graves walls + Decree, bot walks out

arms.name: with_cart
arms.notes: Doorman carts the bot through the hands into Decree

setup.position: Decree 6m behind the wall; bot 20m in front

controls: Cooldowns and HP reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP and resists
procedure: Graves casts Grasping Hands, then Decree
Doorman Carts the bot through the wall toward the gravestone (with_cart)
Count ghoul explosions on the bot and damage over 16s

decision.rule: SUPPORTS if with_cart >=50% higher. REFUTED: drop the pair.
